subject: Renewal consolidation: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian quotes and seat alignment
messages:
From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal consolidation: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian quotes and seat alignment

Team —

Quick context: our three largest developer tool renewals land in the next 60–90 days (GitHub Enterprise, JetBrains All Products Pack, Atlassian cloud). Procurement asked if we want to handle them independently or try a consolidated negotiation to 1) simplify billing/windows, 2) request multi-vendor payment terms, and 3) push for seat discounts based on volume.

What I need from you today:
- Marissa: can you confirm the active seat counts (and any team-level freezes) for JetBrains and Atlassian?
- Laura: is finance comfortable with a consolidated PO that splits payments to multiple vendors but nets a single invoicing cadence? Any constraints on net-30 vs net-45?
- Vivek: any technical constraints (SSO/SAML, license sharing across orgs) that would block an ELA for GitHub or bulk seat reductions?

I asked our vendor contacts to give draft quotes (attached spreadsheet v1) and options for staged rollouts. Goal is to pick a path by EOD next Tuesday so we can lock pricing before end-of-quarter vendor promos.

Attachments: ATL_renewal_bundle_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Thanks —
Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0183

Subject: Re: Renewal consolidation: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian quotes and seat alignment

Hi Ben —

Thanks for the heads up. Attaching an initial GitHub Enterprise quote for your current seat profile. Quick notes:
- We can offer an incremental discount on GitHub seats if you commit to a 24-month ELA and consolidate invoicing through a single procurement contract.
- We can include SAML SSO and SCIM provisioning at no extra licensing cost for Enterprise Cloud.
- DocuSign link below for the current quote if you want to route for signature: https://docusign.com/r/gh-e-sign-2027-04-15

Attachment: GHE_quote_2027-04-15.pdf (pdf stub)

Happy to hop on a quick call with your procurement and finance folks to walk through the pricing buckets.

Best,

sam.patel@github-sales.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, vivek_kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Apr 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal consolidation: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian quotes and seat alignment

Thanks — quick updates after I pulled seat data:
- JetBrains: 420 active seats, but ~40 are for contractors that we plan to offboard over the next 3 months. Recommend we provision for 380 and add a 60-day float for ramp.
- Atlassian (Jira/Confluence): 1,150 users across product and infra; 200 of these are service accounts we can de-duplicate — realistic renewal count ~950.

Questions for the vendors in one go:
- Can JetBrains provide a 12-month true-up instead of a hard seat cap? That would match our contractor churn and avoid overpaying for a full year.
- Atlassian: any discount if we move to an annual prepay vs monthly?

Finance (Laura): if you can confirm a preferred payment window (net-30 vs net-45) and whether we can do a single PO that the vendors can split across invoices, we can push vendors for better pricing. I can also lead negotiations on licensing terms if you want me to.

Marissa
Senior Procurement Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Hi Marissa / Ben —

Thanks for the seat detail. We can accommodate a 12-month true-up for JetBrains subscriptions — we typically do an annual reconciliation but will add a 60-day grace to account for contractor offboarding. I've attached an updated quote (JetBrains_EE_quote_2027-04-17.pdf) that reflects:
- 380 committed seats + 60-day float
- 10% bundled discount if you sign JetBrains and Atlassian via our partner program (Ana at Atlassian partner is looped)
- Option to include enterprise support SLA bump for an additional $X/year (details in the attachment)

Attachment: JetBrains_EE_quote_2027-04-17.pdf (pdf stub)

Subject: RE: Renewal consolidation: GitHub/JetBrains/Atlassian quotes and seat alignment

All —

Thanks for the fast turn. After reviewing the numbers and talking to Finance, we will proceed with the consolidated negotiation path with the following internal signoffs:
- GitHub: proceed with the 24-month ELA to secure the incremental discount Sam outlined. Finance approved net-30 payment terms contingent on a consolidated PO.
- JetBrains: accept 380 committed seats with 60-day true-up as proposed by Elena. Approve the 10% bundled discount if Ana can coordinate combined billing routing.
- Atlassian: proceed with a 950-user renewal; Marissa and Ana to confirm final SKU line items and confirm whether annual prepay yields additional discount.

Next steps for vendors: please send consolidated quote options that show (1) per-vendor breakdown, (2) combined invoice routing option, and (3) DocuSign-ready agreements. We will sign once legal confirms standard T&Cs and finance confirms invoice routing.

Attachments: consolidated renewal spreadsheet (updated) — see Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/renewals/2027/tooling-bundle.xlsx
